## Seznam / Lista / Checklist

- [ ] Fotografije imajo opis (`cover_alt`, `alt` v `figure`). / Photos have alt text.
- [ ] Datoteke za izdelavo so v mapi učila (SVG/DXF/STL/PDF/koda). / Fabrication files are in the aid's folder.
- [ ] Licenca je navedena (`license`) in imam pravico deliti vsebino. / License is set and I have the right to share this.
- [ ] Koraki so preizkušeni – učilo sem res izdelal/a. / Steps are tested – I actually built it.
- [ ] Vsaj en jezik je v celoti izpolnjen (sl, sr ali en). / At least one language is complete.
- [ ] `hugo server` pokaže stran brez napak. / The page builds locally without errors.
